name: Report to Danitha
summary: Danitha Morr asks you to return to Bandarion Keep for further training. Your next step is to speak with her there.

sections.title: A Return to the Keep
sections.body: Danitha Morr is waiting at Bandarion Keep, where she has arranged more training for you. Return to the keep and speak with her to continue.

faq.q: Who wants me to report back?
faq.answer: Danitha Morr asks you to return to Bandarion Keep for additional training.

faq.q: Where do I need to go?
faq.answer: Return to Bandarion Keep and speak with Danitha Morr.

faq.q: Why am I returning to Bandarion Keep?
faq.answer: Danitha Morr has arranged additional training for you at Bandarion Keep.

attribution: In-game quest text: Report to Danitha
